description: Defines a class PostgreSqlStorageForTesting that extends RelationalStorageForTesting, providing PostgreSQL-specific implementations for testing database operations, including connection setup, database creation, deletion, and test query execution.

classes.name: PostgreSqlStorageForTesting
classes.description: A test implementation of relational storage specific to PostgreSQL, providing configuration and utility methods for testing PostgreSQL database interactions.

methods.name: PostgreSqlStorageForTesting
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage with a PostgreSQL connection string, defaulting to a configured default if none is provided.

methods.name: get_CancellationTestQuery
methods.description: Returns a SQL query to test cancellation, involving a sleep to simulate delay.

methods.name: get_CreateStreamTestTable
methods.description: Returns a SQL statement to create a streaming test table with specific schema.

methods.name: get_CreateDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides the SQL template for creating a database with specific encoding and connection limit.

methods.name: get_DropDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides the SQL template for dropping a database forcefully.

methods.name: get_ExistsDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Provides the SQL to check if a database exists by name.

methods.name: ConvertToExecutableBatches
methods.description: Converts setup script and database name into a sequence of SQL batches ready for execution.
